run_f5_tts_cli: run the F5-TTS command line interface to generate speech from text using a reference audio
run_e2_tts_cli: run the E2-TTS command line interface to synthesize speech from reference audio and text
run_batch_voice_switching: run TTS inference with multiple voice tags in the generation text for voice switching
run_tts_with_config: run TTS generation using a TOML configuration file with custom model and audio settings
run_tts_with_options: run TTS CLI with command-line options to override config for speed, NFE steps, and guidance strength
